headline: Huawei guilty of trade secrets plot, not racketeering
pages: A US jury found Huawei guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and of bank fraud, but not guilty of the more serious racketeering charge. The verdict ended a two month trial in a case first announced in 2019. Prosecutors said the Chinese telecom giant spent 20 years lying, cheating and stealing to gain an edge, including lying to banks about its business dealings in Iran and taking secrets from rivals. The defense argued that prosecutors had decided Huawei was a criminal organization and built the case from there, and said its growth in 170 countries came from innovation. Huawei said the racketeering acquittal confirms the allegations lacked a factual basis.
The case has been a major test of US efforts to hold the company accountable. Source: BBC News.
